Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO path for NimbusAI (AWS / Azure marketplaces)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the product demo last week — NimbusAI is excited to move forward with Redwood on both the AWS and Azure marketplace listings. Procurement asked that I confirm the vendor onboarding checklist and PO routing for marketplace payouts and subscription billing. Specifically:

- Which onboarding forms do you need completed by our finance team (W9, vendor intake, bank details)?
- Do we need to submit a separate PO for each cloud marketplace listing or a single master PO?
- Any supplier portal or marketplace portal URLs we should register under?

Can you share the intake packet and a short timeline for activation (including expected listing time once paperwork is complete)? We have a quarterly procurement meeting next Monday and would like to include the timeline.

Thanks,
Ellen Park

ellen.park@nimbusai.com

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO path for NimbusAI (AWS / Azure marketplaces)

Hi Ellen — great to hear. High level answers below and I attached the intake packet.

Summary:
- Required forms: Vendor_Intake_Form, completed W9, and banking instructions (for marketplace payouts).
- PO routing: We accept either a single master PO that covers both marketplace listings (recommended) or separate POs per marketplace. For internal routing, Finance prefers a single PO to reduce manual reconciliation.
- Portal registration: For AWS/Azure/GCP we submit seller information to each marketplace; we will open the marketplace listing records and share the registration links.

Timeline (est):
1) You return intake packet + W9 + bank stub (2–3 business days)
2) Finance review & PO generation (3–5 business days)
3) Marketplace seller registration & listing submission (7–14 business days depending on cloud)

Attachments (stubs): Vendor_Intake_Form_NimbusAI.pdf, Marketplace_PO_Template.docx, Banking-Instructions.pdf

Next steps: Please sign the Vendor_Intake_Form and return with W9 and bank stub. I'll loop in Karthik for the marketplace-side registration once Finance confirms PO terms.

–Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

On Thu, May 20, 2026 at 09:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> From a marketplace activation perspective we can accept a master PO but invoice per marketplace (AWS, Azure).

We can accept a single master PO with line-items split by marketplace; accounting will invoice/recognize per SKU. A few notes:
- Payment terms: standard net 30. If Nimbus requires net 60 that needs approval (advise they supply justification).
- Currency/Banking: confirm bank stub matches W9 (we need routing + account name).
- Tax docs: W9 required for US entities. If Nimbus is non-US, we need W-8BEN/E.

I'll prepare a PO template and confirm whether we need an exception for net 60. Laura — please add marketplace GL codes so we can route correctly.

-Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
